rollback_evidence: ExtremeXOS 33.7.1.6-patch1-11 and EXOS 33.6.1.14 are separate firmware scopes. Port operations require the profile-specific read-back and rollback evidence for the exact firmware and privilege role. Software-image behavior does not establish hardware rollback guarantees. Treat missing or ambiguous clock or configuration-state evidence as unknown and keep write operations blocked. admin-state (disable ports N / enable ports N) is measured on X435-8P-4S and X440-G2-12p-10G4 with 33.7.1.6-patch1-11 only and is refused on other firmware: show configuration then holds the single line 'disable port N' in module vlan and loses it after enable; show ports N information detail reads 'Admin state: Disabled' or 'Enabled'. The timed UPM safeguard runs in non-persistent CLI mode by default, which left 'disable port N' in the configuration after 'enable ports N'; with 'configure cli mode persistent' as its first line it restored both the port and the configuration (measured on both models).
